content:
We hope this gives you enough time to get to grips with the new Legendary item crafting system and prepare you for all the business challenges that await you in Skyline Valley with the release of the new Caravan and Outpost systems!

### Update highlights

- **Legendary Item Crafting** – Craft the weapons and armor of your dreams with this new crafting system that gives you more control over the mods on your Legendary items.
- **Best Build** - This allows you to submit C.A.M.P.s from all corners of the wasteland, visit them and publicly vote for the best ones!
- **Dealer History** – The most important thing about a store is its regular customers. That's why you can now find out who regularly shops at your retailers and give them a friendly wave when you see them in Appalachia!
- **Start Your Own Caravan** – Protect your caravan from raiders and creatures as they make delivery trips through Skyline Valley starting mid-month.

### Update version 1.7.14.15 and download sizes

We're reducing the file size of Fallout 76! Thanks to the efforts of our tech team, the total size of Fallout 76 should now be approximately 95 GB (small differences may vary depending on platform).

To get to this file size, all players will have to download the game again. This is also the reason why the “Milestone Zero” update is larger than usual. Thank you in advance for your patience!

Here you can find out the download size of today's update on the respective platform:

- **PC (Steam)** : 82.07 GB
- **PC (Microsoft Store)** : 96.53 GB
- **Xbox** : 96.6GB
- **PlayStation** : 92.67 GB

### Crafting legendary items

We're excited to introduce this new version of Legendary Item crafting, allowing you to have a more direct impact on the Legendary Mods that are applied to your Legendary items.

Before you can exchange crafted legendary mods on your gear, you must obtain the mod you want to craft in one of the following two ways:

- by trading the mod with other players;
- by utilizing legendary items that have the desired mod.

Every time you craft a Legendary item, you will receive Legendary Tickets and a chance to receive Legendary Mods in the form of a crafting item. Additionally, there is also a chance that you will permanently learn how to craft one of the mods of the item you salvaged. You can trade such loose legendary mods with other players, but once you attach the mod to an item, that item becomes tied to your character and cannot be traded, sold, or dropped.

Once you receive your desired mod, you can attach it to a legendary item of your choice at your armor or weapon workbench in exchange for Legendary Tickets. Every time you swap a mod on an item, the cost of another swap increases.

If you're lucky enough to have learned how to make the mod yourself, you can go to your crafting workbench and make the mod there. The crafting costs vary depending on the mod. To craft mods, you need legendary modules and a number of other items that can be found throughout the wasteland.

To help you try out new mod combinations, we've loosened the restrictions on legendary weapon mods. We look forward to seeing what you put together!

### Legendary Cores are being discontinued

In August, we announced that we would be discontinuing Legendary Cores in order to restructure the currencies used to craft Legendary items. This means that legendary cores are no longer valid from now on
